entities.summary: Huang Yongyu, pen name Huang Xing Bin, Huang Niu, Niu Fuzi, was a scholar of the Tujia ethnicity from Fenghuang, Hunan province, Chinese painter, and former professor of the Central Academy of Fine Arts.
